Name: Free Dusty
Author: Skuld
Description:
[b]NEWS
[/b]
[list]
[*]Updated Dusty's spawn area on the farm and fixed version numbering.
[*]Cross compatibility with my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2132]Cat Gifts Mod﻿﻿[/url]﻿! If Dusty is on your farm because you married Alex, there is a small chance he will dig up a gift for you instead of your cat/dog.
[*]After you marry Alex, Dusty will spawn on your farm or in your house, depending on the weather. Now your cat or dog finally has a companion (Dusty will NOT replace your current pet)!
[*][b]Mod is currently deactivated in multiplayer because of known crashes. You can leave it installed and enjoy it in your single player save.[/b]
[/list]

[b]WHAT THIS DOES[/b]

I was always bothered by the fact that Alex owns a dog but it never left its little box. So now Dusty will actually show up in town! He will be in his little pen or walk around town somewhere.

[b]REQUIREMENTS

[/b]SMAPI 2.10.1 or above

[b]TO DO[/b]

[list]
[*]Improve AI behavior, such as following Alex if he is close, go to sleep at night, etc.
[/list]
[b]THANK YOU[/b]

[list]
[*]sallychan (https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/dusty-dog-mod-additional-color.130485/) for the Dusty sprite.
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Updated mod to be compatible with the future release of SMAPI 3.0. Now requires at least SMAPI 2.10.1.

Manifest.Name: freeDusty
Manifest.Description: Will make Dusty (Alex' dog) spawn in his pen or randomly around town.
